about: P68I T13: zástupné odpovědi písaře skriptu – claude -p z předplatného se zadáním SCRIPT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, NE astra. Kolo 0 = první pokus, 1 = opravné kolo s výpisem chyb.

answers.sentence: a duckling crosses the road and then three little streams to reach its mother
a hedgehog crosses a six lane motorway at rush hour
a raccoon crosses railway tracks twice and then a muddy river with floating logs
a penguin crosses a snowy road and then an icy river with drifting floes
a squirrel crosses a quiet village road and then a wide river on log rafts
a cat crosses a railway yard full of trains
a frog crosses one tiny road and then a huge swamp river
a chicken crosses a highway where every lane is faster than the one before
a lost puppy crosses a market street, a canal and a tram line to get home
a bunny crosses a road and then five rivers in a row
a goose crosses a park road and then a pond with floating branches
a fox crosses a busy road and then the river under the bridge
a snail crosses a slow country road full of tractors
a lizard crosses the desert highway, the old rail line and a dry riverbed with a flash flood
a turtle crosses two small streets and a big busy avenue to reach the sea
a mouse crosses a road, a stream, a road, a stream, again and again
a hen crosses the farm road, the river by the mill and the train line to the market
a beaver crosses a logging road and then rides logs down three river channels
a kitten crosses a road where all the traffic comes from the left
a deer crosses a forest road, a railway and finally a rushing river
